name: Guild Quest Tutorial
description: Learn essential guild functionality and community features

steps.title: Quest Assigned!
steps.description: Great! Your tutorial quest has been assigned. Follow the steps to learn guild functionality. Click Next to continue.

steps.title: Welcome to Guild Functionality!
steps.description: Welcome to the Guild Quest tutorial! You'll learn about governance, treasury management, and community features. Let's start by exploring the Trophy Room to see your tutorial progress.

steps.title: Visit the Trophy Room
steps.description: Click on "Trophy Room" in the Castle to see your achievements and progress. You'll find a special tutorial achievement with 3 stages representing the 3 tutorial quests you can complete.

steps.title: View Tutorial Achievement
steps.description: Great! You can see the "Tutorial Master" achievement with 3 levels. The first stage is already unlocked from completing the Solo Quest tutorial. Complete this Guild Quest to unlock the Epic level!

steps.title: Go to DAO Voting
steps.description: Now let's explore governance! Click on "DAO" in the Castle to see active proposals. There's currently a vote about purchasing a custom skin for the dApp at 5 SOL.

steps.title: Check Vault Funds First
steps.description: Look there is a active vote, but before voting, let's check if we have enough funds. Click on "Vaults" in your castle navigation to see the guild's treasury balance.

steps.title: Filter to Guild Vault
steps.description: Click on the Guild Vault card to see the detailed balance. This will show you exactly how much SOL is available for the skin purchase.

steps.title: Return to DAO and Vote
steps.description: Now let's go back to the DAO and vote yes on the skin purchase proposal. This will help the guild get a unique visual identity!
steps.action: Return to DAO and Vote Yes

steps.title: Vote Yes for Skin Purchase
steps.description: Click "Vote Yes" on the custom skin purchase proposal. This will help the guild get the exclusive Spacebase Yellow skin for a unique visual identity!

steps.title: You Successfully Voted!
steps.description: Excellent! You've successfully voted for the skin purchase. Wait till the vote passes! In the meantime, head over to the Member Profile to complete your profile.

steps.title: Navigate to Member Profile
steps.description: Now let's go to your Member Profile! You can access it by clicking on 'Member Profile' in the top navigation bar, or by going to Castle > Community Hub > Member Profile.

steps.title: Join Our Discord Community
steps.description: This is your Member Profile! Join our Discord by clicking the Discord link in the name field, or move to the next step if you prefer to skip this.

steps.title: Press Community Hub
steps.description: Press Community Hub in your Castle, select Guild Profile. This will show you the guild's updated visual identity with the new skin.

steps.title: The Vote Has Passed!
steps.description: The vote has passed and your guild will now update and implement a new skin. Click Next to load the Spacebase Yellow skin and see the transformation!

steps.title: Complete Guild Quest
steps.description: Perfect! You've experienced some of the guild functionality. Now go to "Guild Quest" in Mission Control and complete the "Tutorial Guild Functionality" quest to finish this tutorial. (in the assigned category)

steps.title: Guild Tutorial Complete!
steps.description: Congratulations! You've mastered guild functionality including governance, treasury management, community features, and visual customization. You're now ready to explore Group Quests to learn about collaborative gameplay!
